# netcup_scp_server_interface (Resource)

Manages a network interface for a netcup SCP server. The interface is created with a VLAN and network driver; the MAC address is returned by the SCP task result and used as the Terraform id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netcup_scp_server_interface" "example" {
  server_id      = 12345
  vlan_id        = 100
  network_driver = "virtio"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_driver` (String) Network driver for this interface (e.g. virtio, e1000, rtl8139).
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server to attach the interface to.
- `vlan_id` (Number) ID of the VLAN for this interface.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform identifier for this network interface (the MAC address).
- `mac` (String) MAC address assigned to this interface by the SCP API.
- `speed_in_mbits` (Number) Interface speed in MBit/s reported by the SCP API.
